About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team 

The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

About the role

Affirm’s Compliance team implements a compliance program that enables Affirm to proactively adhere to regulatory requirements while also identifying and addressing potential regulatory issues that may arise. As a second line of defense, Compliance proactively partners with the business to support new products, markets, initiatives, change management, issue identification and remediation plans, and assessment/monitoring of third parties.

Affirm is actively seeking a Compliance Lead to support certain critical compliance management program elements. In this role, the Compliance Lead will help to administer Compliance’s Testing Program. This includes completing reviews to ensure compliance with federal/state regulations, identifying gaps and deficiencies with regulatory compliance concerns, collaborate with cross functional partners including Legal, Operations, Product, Engineering and senior management to resolve identified issues and further build out our compliance program. This role will report to the Senior Compliance Manager and will be required to work independently and cross-functionally.

What you'll do

  • Perform ongoing compliance testing and reporting on adherence to compliance program and federal/state regulatory requirements.

  • Work closely and cross-functionally with multiple departments (Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, etc.) while completing reviews.

  • Support a very fast paced business with tight deadlines while providing diligent and detailed work product.

title: Staff Security Engineer, Enterprise AI
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The InfoSec team protects Affirm’s systems and data from evolving threats. We manage security risk, monitor vulnerabilities, and enforce protective controls across the company. The team leads incident response, compliance, identity and access management, and employee training. Our goal is to ensure that security is built into every system and decision at Affirm. We maintain a secure, trustworthy environment so the business can operate and grow with confidence.

In this role, you'll build and run Affirm's end-to-end security review process for enterprise AI/LLM systems evaluating architecture, prioritizing AI-specific risks, and designing the controls and guardrails that let Affirm adopt AI safely, partnering across Security, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, IT, and Engineering to make it scalable and repeatable.

What you’ll do

  • You will lead and continuously improve Affirm's enterprise AI security review process  evaluating the architecture, data flows, permissions, and design of internal AI tools, agentic/MCP-based systems, and AI features — and embed security requirements into the design phase.
  • You will threat model AI/LLM-based systems and their data flows for risks such as prompt injection, insecure output handling, excessive agency, tool-permission abuse, data poisoning, and sensitive-data exposure, and drive remediation.
  • You will review source code, system prompts, agent configurations, and tool/permission manifests (e.g., MCP definitions), and help tool owners build security-focused test cases and red-team/eval scenarios to verify requirements before launch.
  • You will design and build security guardrails and tooling for AI systems permission boundaries, authn/authz for agentic tools and MCP servers, data-handling controls, logging/monitoring, and policy-as-code (Python, IaC) — to enforce and automate AI security.
  • You will evaluate the AI capabilities of third-party SaaS vendors (e.g., Notion, Slack, Google Workspace) as part of vendor and SaaS security reviews and drive risk-based adoption decisions.
  • You will identify emerging classes of AI/agentic security vulnerabilities, develop mitigations before they become incidents, and contribute to AI-specific incident response playbooks as a senior escalation point.
  • You will lead cross-functional AI security initiatives to closure, advise technical and executive stakeholders as an internal point of expertise, and stay current on the AI security landscape (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS) to translate new research into practical controls.

What we look for

  • You are a seasoned security engineer with hands-on experience designing, evaluating, and maintaining security architecture for AI/LLM-based systems, plus deep expertise in enterprise security systems, processes, and controls.
  • You have practical experience threat modeling and reviewing AI/LLM applications (e.g., against the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and securing agentic systems and tool-calling frameworks — MCP servers/clients, tool-permission models, and agent-to-tool trust boundaries.
  • You have built AI governance artifacts (acceptable use policy, data-handling standards, vendor/model risk assessments) and evaluated AI capabilities within SaaS platforms (e.g., Notion AI, Slack AI, Google Workspace AI, GitHub Copilot) as part of vendor reviews.
  • You have experience with enterprise tools for AI visibility and control (e.g., CASB, IDP/Okta) and familiarity with the corporate systems where AI is adopted (OpenAI, Anthropic, GitHub, Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Jira).
  • You can build security tooling, guardrails, and detections with Python or similar, and deploy cloud services and policy-as-code using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or similar); familiarity with Kubernetes and AWS.
  • You understand how LLMs and agentic systems are built (RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, tool use) and authn/authz models (OAuth2, SAML, service-account/non-human identities) for agentic and machine-to-machine access, with strong application-architecture and threat-modeling fundamentals.
  • You can lead cross-functional initiatives across Security, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and Compliance and drive them to closure, and communicate effectively with technical and executive audiences. Experience in regulated environments (SOC 2, PCI DSS) and applying IAM to non-human/agent identities is a plus.

Equity Grade - 13

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Consumer Authentication Platform)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Consumer Authentication Platform team is looking for a passionate Senior Software Engineer to help build the secure, reliable, and seamless authentication experiences that connect millions of consumers with Affirm’s financial products.

Authentication is the front door to Affirm. Our systems power critical consumer journeys (including sign-up, sign-in, account recovery, checkout authentication, step-up challenges, session management, and connected merchant experiences) across thousands of merchants and multiple countries. We build foundational capabilities such as authentication factors, identity federation, session and authorization services, and risk-based authentication that protect consumers while minimizing unnecessary friction. We work closely with Product, Security, Fraud, Identity, Analytics, Compliance, Data Science, and a wide range of engineering teams to both leverage existing systems and build new systems. This role requires a high level of technical capability, strong cross-functional communication, and a creative mindset. Our work needs to be secure, reliable, correct, scalable, and extensible. Our job is to build an authentication platform that balances security, regulatory requirements, fraud prevention, customer experience, and business growth.

As a senior engineer, you will lead significant technical initiatives, influence the architecture and evolution of the platform, and help the team deliver secure authentication capabilities that can be reused across products, merchants, and geographies.

What You’ll Do

  • You will own the technical design and delivery of significant authentication platform capabilities, leading projects from early requirements and architecture through implementation, rollout, and ongoing operation.
  • You will build secure, highly available systems that support consumer sign-in, authentication factors, account recovery, step-up authentication, session management, authorization, and identity federation.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, Security, Fraud, Compliance, design, and analytics; participating in ideation; articulating technical constraints; and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will translate security, regulatory, fraud, and customer-experience requirements into pragmatic technical designs that appropriately balance risk, friction, complexity, and delivery speed.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology, security, reliability, or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on,” and on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality, security, and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, mentoring other engineers through design reviews and hands-on collaboration, and leading by example.
  • You will clearly communicate technical decisions, constraints, risks, and trade-offs to engineering and non-engineering audiences through design documents, reviews, and technical discussions. You will lead the investigation and resolution of complex production issues and identify systemic improvements that prevent recurrence.

What We Look For

  • You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python, Kotlin, Java, or another comparable modern programming language.
  • You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes, as well as relational databases, event-driven architectures, and RPC or API frameworks.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, secure, simple, and extensible design. You write high-quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large codebase and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely, including testing strategies, migration plans, and controlled rollouts.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, manager, and stakeholders, while helping other engineers grow through mentorship and technical leadership.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team and cross-functional partners.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • Familiarity with standards and protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, WebAuthn/passkeys, FIDO2, JWTs, and public-key cryptography. Knowledge of security and assurance frameworks such as the NIST Digital Identity Guidelines or PCI DSS.
  • Experience designing session-management, token-issuance, account-recovery, or multi-factor authentication systems. Familiarity with risk-based or adaptive authentication and the interaction between identity, security, compliance, and fraud controls.

In this role, you’ll help leaders operate effectively by managing calendars, coordinating travel and events, supporting meeting preparation, and maintaining strong documentation and record-keeping practices.

You’ll partner closely with teams in the UK and internationally, including the Affirm Leadership Support Team, and cross-functional partners across the business. You’ll report directly to the VP, Country Manager UK.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide high-quality administrative support to one Vice President

  • Manage inboxes, calendars, scheduling, and meeting prioritisation to help leaders use their time effectively

  • Co-ordinate core meetings in the daily / weekly / monthly operating plan, ensuring attendance, drafting and distributing agendas, preparing materials, creating decks / notion pages, communicating with attendees and ensuring follow up actions are  shared in a timely manner and tracked to completion.

title: Senior Director, Product Management (Financial Platforms)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product team 

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the role

Affirm’s financial platforms power how loans are created, recorded, funded, serviced, and repaid, as well as how money moves across our products, partners, and markets. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product Management to lead a portfolio spanning Capital and Affirm Bank, Loan Products, and Payment Services.

This leader will oversee a large, multi-domain product organization of approximately 15 product managers, including experienced people managers, with room to grow. They will set the long-term strategy for their portfolio, modernize Affirm’s ledger and downstream financial pipelines, strengthen Payment Services, and expand our Money Movement capabilities. The ideal candidate brings deep financial-domain knowledge, strong platform judgment, international experience, and a record of developing senior product leaders.

What you’ll do

  • Lead and scale a high-performing product organization. Manage and develop experienced product leaders and people managers across Capital and Affirm Bank, Loan Products, and Payment Services. Shape the organization as its scope and size grow, while setting a high bar for product craft, strategy, execution, and talent development.
  • Set the multi-year strategy for the portfolio. Establish a coherent direction across lending, Capital Markets, banking, the loan lifecycle, ledger and accounting capabilities, Money Movement, Open Banking, payment instruments, and processing.
  • Modernize Affirm’s ledger and financial pipelines. Lead the strategy for evolving the systems that record and reconcile financial activity and support downstream Capital Markets, accounting, reporting, and Money Movement workflows. Improve scalability, reliability, controls, and development speed while protecting critical financial operations.
  • Strengthen Payment Services. Develop the strategy for Open Banking, payment instruments, processing, routing, and related payment infrastructure. Improve payment success, resilience, processing flexibility, and transaction economics across Affirm’s products and markets.
  • Expand Money Movement capabilities. Build the platforms and controls needed to support new account-based products, funds flows, payment rails, and financial experiences. Ensure settlement, reconciliation, reporting, and operational processes can scale with increasing product and geographic complexity.
  • Advance Affirm’s lending, capital, and banking platforms. Guide the evolution of Loan Products, loan-lifecycle capabilities, Capital Markets systems, and Affirm Bank infrastructure. Develop shared capabilities that support new products and reduce fragmentation across financial systems.
  • Deliver meaningful business and customer impact. Establish clear goals and success metrics across platform reliability, payment performance, processing costs, reconciliation accuracy, operational efficiency, financial controls, and the speed of launching new products and markets.
  • Make sound platform investment decisions. Balance architectural modernization with product growth, regulatory requirements, operational risk, and near-term business needs. Establish clear sequencing and migration strategies for complex, interconnected systems.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment at scale. Partner closely with Engineering, Analytics, Capital Markets, Treasury, Finance, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Servicing to establish shared priorities and translate strategy into coordinated execution.
  • Enable global scale. Build platform capabilities that support international markets and account for differences in payment rails, banking relationships, currencies, regulation, legal entities, controls, and operating models.
  • Influence senior leadership. Clearly communicate strategy, investment priorities, performance, dependencies, and tradeoffs to executive stakeholders. Help shape decisions across the broader Financial Platforms organization.

What we look for

  • 15+ years of product management experience, including leading large, high-performing teams of PMs and people managers across multiple domains
  • Demonstrated manager-of-managers experience, including developing senior leaders, designing organizations, hiring strong teams, and managing through growth and change
  • Substantial experience across several relevant domains, including lending, Capital Markets, regulated banking, financial ledgers or accounting systems, Money Movement, payment processing, Open Banking, or consumer payments
  • Direct experience leading complex platform or architecture transformations involving high-stakes financial systems
  • Proven ability to define and execute multi-year strategies spanning customer experiences, complex platforms, and operational capabilities
  • Strong knowledge of how money moves across financial products, institutions, processors, bank partners, and markets, including settlement, reconciliation, reporting, and operational controls
  • Experience building financial products or platforms across multiple countries and navigating differences in payment rails, banking relationships, regulation, legal entities, currencies, and operating models
  • Track record of driving alignment and execution across Engineering, Analytics, Capital Markets, Treasury, Finance, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and executive leadership
  • Exceptional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to create clarity, influence senior stakeholders, and develop strong product leaders
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted tools to accelerate analysis, decision-making, and team effectiveness
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Operations team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role

As we scale into new products, partners, geographies, and channels, we need an exceptional leader to own the strategy of how our servicing operating model evolves globally. In this role you'll set the customer operations strategy for a portfolio of complex, cross-functional expansion programs, lead a team of program and process managers, and be accountable for adapting the servicing model to new and differentiated products across markets. In addition, you will be the leader who represents operations across international business teams providing transparency into performance and partnering across product, engineering, and operations to help drive continuous improvement in service delivery for international customers. The ideal candidate pairs strong business acumen and judgment with the ability to lead teams, shape ambiguous problem spaces into clear operating plans, and influence senior partners across the company. A deep passion for growing international businesses and working to understand the localization needs for customer experience and being able to implement with scale and efficiency will be key. 

This role requires deep expertise in the customer/merchant servicing space and a strong grounding in financial services. You'll own a portfolio that spans a multitude of international servicing landscapes — launching, testing and learning in operations, and scaling geo expansions, new product scaling, and new channel expansion — and you'll build the standards, methods, and team that make those programs repeatable at global scale via playbooks.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for how Customer Operations scales to support global expansion — new products, merchants/partners, geo launches, and channels — translating ambiguous, undefined business direction into structured programs and clear operating plans.
  • Establish and modify the team's operational objectives, policies, procedures, and work plans; define the methods, frameworks, and success criteria used to run initiatives across regions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team spanning two or more disciplines (e.g., program management and service delivery via process/continuous improvement); oversee professionals and, where applicable, other people leaders; delegate assignments and ensure effective execution.
  • Drive the strategy and success of large-scale, cross-area programs for operations— merchant/geo launches, automation and efficiency programs, new-product scaling — managing scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, and risk across a complex, multi-market servicing landscape.
  • Partner in lock step with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Risk, Training, Knowledge, and Service Delivery leads to run cross-functional discovery and scoping, coordinate planning, and oversee dependencies through the full program lifecycle.
  • Build alignment across mid- to senior-level leaders cross-functionally; influence outcomes in complex or sensitive situations while strengthening those relationships.
  • Own portfolio-level governance (working groups, weekly/monthly business reviews) to drive awareness, issue resolution, and decision-making; be accountable for decisions that affect team, program, and overall business results over a medium-term (1yr+) horizon and that can carry company-wide effects.
  • Own post-launch operational performance for the global international operations portfolio and set up rituals and roles to support global business teams with transparent performance and improvement plans across servicing and operations. 
  • Serve as a recognized subject-matter expert and thought leader on the global servicing operating model; build networks and represent Customer Operations on broader, organization-wide initiatives.
  • Champion an analytical, data-driven culture within the team and across Product, Analytics, Engineering, and the broader business.
  • Develop communication and change-management plans for the portfolio, and own the processes for logging and tracking risks, issues, actions, and dependencies.
  • Represent the unique customer servicing needs of global customers at scale across core operations.

What We Look For

  • 12+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading teams and/or managing other managers or senior professionals.
  • Experience building and scaling global customer experience operations and working in global environments across cultures and geographies. 
  • Deep program and process management expertise (PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt a plus), with a track record of defining methods and standards — not just applying them.
  • Broad, cross-disciplinary expertise and a strong understanding of how the wider organization and market operate, complemented by deep functional knowledge of customer care, fraud, and/or merchant operations (processes, systems, and key metrics).
  • Strong knowledge of how shared services operate; experience in services, operations, and/or sales.
  • Experience delivering programs across multiple geographies or markets strongly preferred; consumer lending or financial services background strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to work on unique, poorly defined problems that lack strategic direction — evaluating intangibles, applying conceptual thinking, and creating the approach and evaluation criteria.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build alignment among diverse, senior stakeholders in complex or sensitive situations.
  • Sound judgment to make discretionary decisions with significant latitude, balancing research, creativity, and business impact.
  • Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency, accountability, and results orientation, and a genuine enthusiasm for developing people and building new capabilities.

title: Senior Manager, Programs - Global Expansion and New Initiatives
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Operations team
The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role
As we scale into new products, partners, geographies, and channels, we need an exceptional leader to own the strategy of how our servicing operating model evolves globally. In this role you'll set the customer operations strategy for a portfolio of complex, cross-functional expansion programs, lead a team of program and process managers, and be accountable for adapting the servicing model to new and differentiated products across markets. In addition, you will be the leader who represents operations across international business teams providing transparency into performance and partnering across product, engineering, and operations to help drive continuous improvement in service delivery for international customers. The ideal candidate pairs strong business acumen and judgment with the ability to lead teams, shape ambiguous problem spaces into clear operating plans, and influence senior partners across the company. A deep passion for growing international businesses and working to understand the localization needs for customer experience and being able to implement with scale and efficiency will be key. 

This role requires deep expertise in the customer/merchant servicing space and a strong grounding in financial services. You'll own a portfolio that spans a multitude of international servicing landscapes — launching, testing and learning in operations, and scaling geo expansions, new product scaling, and new channel expansion — and you'll build the standards, methods, and team that make those programs repeatable at global scale via playbooks.

What You'll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for how Customer Operations scales to support global expansion — new products, merchants/partners, geo launches, and channels — translating ambiguous, undefined business direction into structured programs and clear operating plans.
  • Establish and modify the team's operational objectives, policies, procedures, and work plans; define the methods, frameworks, and success criteria used to run initiatives across regions.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team spanning two or more disciplines (e.g., program management and service delivery via process/continuous improvement); oversee professionals and, where applicable, other people leaders; delegate assignments and ensure effective execution.
  • Drive the strategy and success of large-scale, cross-area programs for operations— merchant/geo launches, automation and efficiency programs, new-product scaling — managing scope, schedule, budget, dependencies, and risk across a complex, multi-market servicing landscape.
  • Partner in lock step with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Risk, Training, Knowledge, and Service Delivery leads to run cross-functional discovery and scoping, coordinate planning, and oversee dependencies through the full program lifecycle.
  • Build alignment across mid- to senior-level leaders cross-functionally; influence outcomes in complex or sensitive situations while strengthening those relationships.
  • Own portfolio-level governance (working groups, weekly/monthly business reviews) to drive awareness, issue resolution, and decision-making; be accountable for decisions that affect team, program, and overall business results over a medium-term (1yr+) horizon and that can carry company-wide effects.
  • Own post-launch operational performance for the global international operations portfolio and set up rituals and roles to support global business teams with transparent performance and improvement plans across servicing and operations. 
  • Serve as a recognized subject-matter expert and thought leader on the global servicing operating model; build networks and represent Customer Operations on broader, organization-wide initiatives.
  • Champion an analytical, data-driven culture within the team and across Product, Analytics, Engineering, and the broader business.
  • Develop communication and change-management plans for the portfolio, and own the processes for logging and tracking risks, issues, actions, and dependencies.
  • Represent the unique customer servicing needs of global customers at scale across core operations.

What We Look For

  • 12+ years of relevant experience, including 5+ years leading teams and/or managing other managers or senior professionals.
  • Experience building and scaling global customer experience operations and working in global environments across cultures and geographies. 
  • Deep program and process management expertise (PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt a plus), with a track record of defining methods and standards — not just applying them.
  • Broad, cross-disciplinary expertise and a strong understanding of how the wider organization and market operate, complemented by deep functional knowledge of customer care, fraud, and/or merchant operations (processes, systems, and key metrics).
  • Strong knowledge of how shared services operate; experience in services, operations, and/or sales.
  • Experience delivering programs across multiple geographies or markets strongly preferred; consumer lending or financial services background strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to work on unique, poorly defined problems that lack strategic direction — evaluating intangibles, applying conceptual thinking, and creating the approach and evaluation criteria.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence and build alignment among diverse, senior stakeholders in complex or sensitive situations.
  • Sound judgment to make discretionary decisions with significant latitude, balancing research, creativity, and business impact.
  • Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency, accountability, and results orientation, and a genuine enthusiasm for developing people and building new capabilities.

title: Analytics Lead, Deposit Fraud Risk
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Fraud team at Affirm Bank works cross-functionally with Machine Learning, Product, Engineering, Operations to combat fraudulent activities to foster a safe platform. 

This role requires abundant cross-functional partnership. This individual will be the representative of the Credit Risk org, leading the charge on refining our Identity Verification and Fraud processes as well as our Application flow. Additionally, this role will work closely with the Product and Engineering teams to improve our Fraud solution. 

Come join us in our mission to change consumer finance through better technology, lower costs, and increased transparency while providing the best customer experience.  

What You'll Do

This role will take charge of owning fraud performance for depository products, including monitoring fraud losses, approval rates, false positives, customer friction, and other key risk metrics 

Data Pipeline, Analytics & Monitoring

  • Build and maintain scalable data models and transformation pipelines, using tools (such as DBT) to standardize depository product, transaction, customer, fraud, and operational data.
  • Define trusted fraud performance metrics and analytical datasets, including fraud loss rates, approval and decline rates, false-positive rates, customer friction, and operational efficiency.
  • Develop recurring dashboards, scorecards, and monitoring frameworks to provide clear visibility into fraud performance, portfolio health, and emerging risks.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose fraud losses, control gaps, false positives, portfolio shifts, and unexpected performance changes, translating findings into actionable recommendations.

Fraud Strategy Building & Optimization

  • Develop and optimize fraud rules, policies, thresholds, models, and decision strategies that balance loss prevention, customer experience, operational capacity, and product growth.
  • Evaluate new data sources and signals to improve detection of identity risk, account takeover, device risk, transaction risk, and other fraud typologies relevant to depository products.
  • Lead testing and performance measurement of fraud strategy changes, including rule launches, model updates, policy changes, and new product controls, with clear pre- and post-implementation evaluation.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Engineering, Fraud Operations, and Risk to improve fraud strategies, strengthen operational feedback loops, and support new product launches.

What We Look For

  • EXPERIENCE - 7+ years’ of Analytics experience
  • PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE - Passion to understand how Affirm product works and a curious mindset to help change and make it more effective
  • TECHNICAL SKILLS - Fluent in SQL and Python
  • PEOPLE SKILLS - A team player with ability to collaborate and influence across many different teams in the organization
  • COMMUNICATION - Ability to communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • EXECUTION - Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment and be responsive and available during times of peak fraud activity
  • MULTI-TASKING - Strong time management skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities
  • RISK KNOWLEDGE  - Working knowledge of the fundamentals of payment processing and an understanding of industry risk trends, including familiarity with fraud strategy development

title: Group Product Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product Marketing team

The Product Marketing team brings intellectual curiosity to understanding our customers, our market, and where Affirm can create value. We ask questions, challenge assumptions, and turn what we learn into product recommendations and focused go-to-market strategies. We’re the connective tissue across Product, Analytics, Revenue, and Marketing, building a shared understanding of who we’re serving, what matters to them, and how we’ll drive adoption and growth. We’re also storytellers: we make complex products easy to understand and give merchants and consumers a clear, compelling reason to choose Affirm.

About the Role

As a Group Product Marketing Manager, you’ll own the strategy and systems that drive product marketing excellence across Affirm’s B2B organization. You’ll synthesize merchant, consumer, market, and performance insights across our portfolio to shape shared strategy, strengthen our merchant narrative, and guide product and go-to-market investments. You’ll establish the frameworks, standards, and operating mechanisms that improve segmentation, go-to-market planning, and measurement across teams. Alongside this portfolio-wide mandate, you’ll directly lead a focused set of critical, ambiguous cross-portfolio opportunities from discovery through commercialization. This senior individual contributor role will create leverage across the broader Product Marketing team, raising the quality, consistency, and impact of our work.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and evolve the portfolio narrative: Develop Affirm’s merchant story, messaging architecture, and proof points. Partner with Brand and other Marketing teams to connect it to Affirm’s broader brand story and activate it across priority merchant channels.

  • Connect product and GTM teams: Establish operating rhythms that sustain alignment across teams, with deeper coordination at critical moments such as planning, forecasting, launches, and strategic client opportunities.

  • Equip Revenue teams to tell the story: Partner with Revenue Enablement to turn the portfolio narrative into messaging, tools, training, and proof points that strengthen merchant conversations across the field.

  • Lead Voice of the Merchant: Own Affirm’s Client Advisory Board and broader merchant feedback loops. Turn insights from strategic merchants, Revenue teams, research, and performance data into product priorities, go-to-market decisions, and pilot or co-development opportunities.

  • Lead critical initiatives: Own a limited number of high-priority, ambiguous opportunities, such as strategic commerce and payments platform partnerships or new market launches. 

  • Be a culture carrier: model Affirm’s values and set a high bar for how teams collaborate, make decisions, and learn. Build trust across functions, create an inclusive environment for candid debate and thoughtful risk-taking, and coach others to do their best work.


What We’re Looking For

  • 12+ years of experience in product marketing, product strategy, or a related field, with depth in B2B payments, fintech, commerce, or platform businesses.

  • A track record of setting strategic direction and delivering measurable outcomes for a significant product portfolio or business area.

  • A strong portfolio storyteller who can connect complex products into a clear narrative for senior leaders, merchants, and partners.

  • Exceptional strategic and business judgment. You can turn merchant, consumer, market, and performance insights into product priorities, business cases, and investment recommendations.

  • Proven ability to influence senior leaders, resolve tradeoffs, and build alignment across Product, Revenue, Partnerships, Analytics, and Marketing.

  • Strong self-serve analytical skills. You’re comfortable using SQL, dashboards, and AI-assisted analysis to investigate questions, test hypotheses, and decide when to scale, adjust, or stop.

  • High AI fluency and a track record of improving the quality and speed of your own work while helping others do the same, using AI for tasks such as synthesizing research, analyzing data, automating workflows, and building reusable tools.

  • Experience building reusable frameworks and operating mechanisms that improve segmentation, go-to-market planning, launches, and measurement across teams.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Card Loan Platform)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Card Loan Platform team builds the high-throughput decision engine at the heart of Affirm’s card products. Unlike traditional cards, every pay-later transaction is backed by its own unique loan, and our system is the "invisible piping" that makes this complex model work at scale. Every swipe triggers our platform to solve a hard problem in milliseconds: matching messy, fragmented payment network data to the correct loan to drive real-time approvals, origination, and refunds.

As Affirm experiences explosive growth, our team's contributions are a key enabler. This isn't just another backend role; you'll be building the "financial brain" for our flagship card products, with your work on the critical path for every single swipe. We're tackling a unique, high-stakes distributed systems challenge that demands exceptional correctness and massive scale. You will partner closely with product, data science, and engineering teams to design and build the future of our industry-leading money movement platform.

If you are passionate about making foundational design decisions and building a beloved, lasting financial brand—come join us. It’s going to be an amazing ride!

What you'll do

  • Drive technical strategy by leading the planning, prioritization, and execution of projects, ensuring alignment with product, technical, and business goals.
  • Lead the end-to-end system design and development of large-scale, high-availability services. This includes building robust APIs and data models for our micro-service and event-driven architectures.
  • Collaborate across functions with partners in Product, Analytics, Design, Legal, and Accounting and to define requirements and execute our card loan attribution and lifecycle strategy.
  • Ensure system health and performance by analyzing and troubleshooting complex technical issues, optimizing existing code, and driving solutions that focus on long-term robustness and scalability.
  • Mentor and grow the team by guiding junior engineers, leading technical discussions and design reviews, and championing best practices through code review.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience in software development or engineering, with a deep understanding of system design and architecture.
  • Motivated leader, inspiring team growth and fostering a culture of continuous learning
  • Excellent communicator, adept at sharing complex ideas with diverse audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a creative and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python, Kotlin, or similar.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Knowledge of database systems (SQL, NoSQL), web frameworks, and RESTful API development.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - N

Equity Grade - USA 9

title: Small Business Account Executive II
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the role

Affirm is seeking an experienced, quota-carrying Account Executive to own the full sales cycle for complex, high-growth merchants across the upper SMB and Mid-Market segment. This portfolio includes merchants with up to $300M in total annual sales and requires a seller who can operate as the general manager of a territory, create demand, engage executive decision-makers, build a quantified business case, structure a compelling commercial solution, and lead the opportunity through contract and launch.

The Account Executive is accountable for new merchant acquisition and the long-term quality of each partnership. The role translates merchant priorities into solutions across Affirm's products and capabilities, while aligning internal stakeholders across Sales, Merchant Pricing, Product, Partnerships, Risk, Legal, Operations, Implementation, and Merchant Success. Success requires strategic prospecting, strong financial and commercial judgment, fluency in technical and operational requirements, and the ability to create momentum across complex buying groups.


What you will do

  • Own a defined territory and revenue plan. Operate as the general manager of a portfolio that includes complex, high-growth merchants with up to $300M in total annual sales. Develop the account strategy, prioritization model, pipeline plan, and execution cadence required to achieve signed GMV and revenue targets.
  • Generate and develop net-new pipeline. Research priority merchants, identify relevant business and market triggers, and use targeted outbound, partner channels, events, referrals, and internal resources to create qualified opportunities.
  • Lead executive discovery. Engage founders, C-suite executives, and senior leaders across Finance, E-commerce, Product, Technology, Operations, and Marketing to understand strategic priorities, operating constraints, customer economics, and decision criteria.
  • Set the strategy for complex opportunities. Independently determine the account plan, stakeholder engagement strategy, competitive positioning, internal resource requirements, negotiation posture, and path to close for each opportunity.
  • Build quantified business cases. Translate merchant data and objectives into clear recommendations supported by expected conversion, average order value, customer acquisition, repeat purchase, GMV, revenue, unit economics, and operational impact.
  • Design the merchant solution. Partner with Sales Engineering and Onboarding to define the appropriate product configuration, integration path, rollout strategy, and customer experience. Lead opportunities that may require customized payment configurations, e-commerce platform integrations, technical solutioning, or multi-entity implementation planning.
  • Navigate complex buying processes. Build champions, map stakeholders, align economic buyers and technical evaluators, manage procurement, security, legal, and risk requirements, and establish a mutual action plan through decision and signature.
  • Lead commercial negotiations. Develop deal strategy, position differentiated value, handle objections, and negotiate pricing, terms, and partnership structure. Evaluate merchant requirements against expected GMV, revenue, unit economics, implementation complexity, and risk while protecting Affirm’s long-term financial interests.
  • Develop recommendations for non-standard partnerships. Use sound commercial judgment to structure and present recommendations involving custom pricing, contractual terms, product requirements, implementation investments, or other exceptions requiring internal approval.
  • Lead cross-functional deal teams. Lead virtual teams without direct authority by establishing clear owners, operating cadence, decision points, escalation paths, and timelines across Partnerships, Risk, Legal, Implementation, and Merchant Pricing.
  • Own the path from signature to launch. Remain accountable for a successful handoff and project-manage critical launch dependencies so signed merchants progress efficiently toward integration and go-live.
  • Maintain forecast and operating discipline. Keep Salesforce current, accurately assess deal stage and material risk, provide reliable weekly and quarterly forecasts, and communicate changes early with a clear recovery plan.
  • Represent the market internally. Bring structured merchant, industry, and competitive insights to product and business partners, identify recurring barriers, and influence scalable improvements to Affirm’s products and go-to-market motion.
  • Raise team performance. Share effective account strategies, executive messaging, business cases, and deal practices. Contribute to a high-accountability culture focused on customer value, commercial discipline, and measurable outcomes.

What success looks like

  • Revenue and GMV attainment. Consistently meet or exceed signed annualized estimated GMV and revenue goals across a portfolio of upper-SMB and Mid-Market merchants.
  • Pipeline creation and quality. Maintain sufficient qualified coverage through self-generated and partner-supported pipeline, supported by clear account prioritization, stakeholder access, and actionable next steps.
  • Conversion and velocity. Advance qualified opportunities with healthy win rates, disciplined stage progression, and sales cycles appropriate to the size and complexity of each partnership.
  • Commercial quality. Structure partnerships that balance merchant value with Affirm’s revenue, unit economics, implementation requirements, and risk considerations.
  • Forecast accuracy. Provide a reliable view of expected outcomes, material risks, decision criteria, and timing based on evidence and confirmed buyer commitments.
  • Executive engagement. Establish credibility with senior decision-makers, build effective internal champions, and maintain alignment across complex buying groups.
  • Launch quality. Ensure signed merchants transition effectively into implementation and progress toward go-live with aligned scope, owners, technical requirements, and timelines.
  • Cross-functional leadership. Create clarity, accountability, and momentum across internal teams while representing both merchant needs and Affirm’s business requirements.
  • Organizational impact. Surface recurring merchant and market insights that improve product capabilities, remove operating barriers, and strengthen Affirm’s broader go-to-market execution.

What we look for

  • 4 or more years of quota-carrying, full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, e-commerce, or another complex technology environment.
  • A demonstrated record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets and creating self-sourced pipeline in a new-logo acquisition role.
  • Experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and building relationships with executive and functional decision-makers.
  • Strong consultative discovery, objection handling, negotiation, and closing skills, including the ability to establish a clear decision process and mutual action plan.
  • Ability to analyze merchant and market data, develop a quantified business case, and communicate financial and strategic value with credibility.
  • Experience coordinating legal, risk, technical, pricing, operational, and implementation stakeholders to resolve barriers and close business.
  • Strong territory planning, pipeline management, CRM discipline, and forecasting capabilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive presentations and concise internal updates.
  • High ownership, sound judgment, resilience, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-changing environment with multiple priorities.

Preferred experience

  • Experience selling payment, lending, commerce, financial software, or other solutions that require technical integration and commercial structuring.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms, APIs, payment flows, implementation requirements, and merchant economics.
  • Experience using a structured sales methodology such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Sandler.
  • Prior experience in business development or another role requiring high-volume prospecting and disciplined pipeline creation.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Role requirements

  • Ability to work effectively in a remote environment and collaborate across functions and time zones.
  • Ability to travel periodically for merchant meetings, industry events, and internal team sessions as business needs require.
  • Authorization to work in the United States without current or future visa sponsorship.

title: Staff Product Manager, Credit & Pricing
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product Team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the Role

As a Staff Product Manager on Affirm’s Credit & Pricing team, you’ll shape how consumers discover, understand, and use available credit. You’ll own the strategy for credit experiences spanning shopping, repayment, and marketing, turning complex credit capabilities into intuitive products that build trust and drive activation, conversion, and repeat engagement.

What You'll Do

  • Set the product direction. Define a cohesive vision for consumer credit experiences, identify the most valuable problems to solve, and translate your strategy into priorities across multiple teams.
  • Build experiences that make credit understandable. Help consumers explore potential financing options before checkout, discover where they have purchasing power, and understand when credit becomes available again after repayment.
  • Create more relevant consumer journeys. Develop personalized experiences for new and returning consumers, using research and experimentation to determine what information, guidance, and next steps best meet their needs.
  • Connect platform capabilities to consumer outcomes. Own merchant prequalification and purchasing power experiences, partnering with core purchasing power and credit decisioning teams to translate underlying capabilities into clear, consistent experiences.
  • Lead consequential product decisions. Bring Engineering, Design, Analytics, Credit, Marketing, Commercial, and Legal partners together to resolve tradeoffs across consumer needs, growth, risk, and partner commitments. Influence senior leaders through clear recommendations and sound judgment.
  • Own measurable results. Define success, lead discovery and experimentation, and use funnel analysis and consumer feedback to improve activation, purchase conversion, repeat engagement, and comprehension while supporting responsible access to credit.

What We Look For

  • A record of building impactful consumer products. 7+ years of product management experience, with demonstrated success taking products from discovery through launch and scaling adoption in fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces, or similarly complex environments.
  • Leadership across teams. Experience independently setting direction for a substantial product area, influencing senior stakeholders, and aligning multiple teams around priorities and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong consumer product judgment. An ability to translate complex systems into intuitive experiences, with a high bar for interaction design, clear communication, and consumer trust.
  • Strategic and technical depth. You connect long-term opportunities to practical product and platform decisions, and work effectively with engineers on capabilities that serve multiple experiences.
  • Analytical and experimental rigor. You combine customer research, behavioral data, and well-designed experiments to prioritize opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, and decide what to scale, change, or stop.
  • Ownership in ambiguity. You bring structure to open-ended problems, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and communicate the rationale, risks, and support needed to move forward.
  • Relevant domain curiosity. Experience with credit, lending, personalization, or AI-powered consumer experiences is a plus. You can learn complex domains quickly and distinguish useful innovation from technology without a clear customer need.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

descriptionHtml:

About the role

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to help shape the next generation of Affirm’s Comms Plat. Together, this work will simplify how teams build and manage communications, strengthen the reliability and scalability of our systems, and help us deliver more relevant and consistent customer experiences.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering and teams across Product, Marketing, Ops, Design, Analytics, and Legal and Compliance to set product direction and turn it into capabilities teams can successfully adopt. You’ll navigate complex technical and business tradeoffs, balance near-term needs with longer-term platform investments, and help determine where Affirm should build capabilities directly versus work with third-party partners.

What you'll do 

  • Set product strategy and roadmap for Comms Plat, connecting customer needs, business priorities, and technical opportunities.

  • Help modernize Affirm’s comms infrastructure and build shared capabilities that support more consistent experiences across transactional and marketing comms.

  • Lead complex platform initiatives from strategy through launch and adoption, working closely with Engineering and cross-functional partners.

  • Build strong relationships across Affirm so communications needs for new products, markets, and customer journeys are understood early and reflected in platform plans.

  • Shape channel, platform, and partner strategy, including thoughtful build-versus-buy decisions across the communications ecosystem.

  • Define meaningful measures of success and use customer, product, operational, and business signals to guide priorities and investment.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (Online Storage)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Data and Storage Services team is responsible for Affirm's data infrastructure across OLTP and OLAP systems, spanning critical online checkout databases, batch orchestration, streaming infrastructure, event-driven frameworks, BI, analytics tooling, large-scale data platforms, and agentic data tools such as semantic layers and internal platform data applications. Our mission is to provide trustworthy, intuitive, and cost-efficient solutions for Affirmers to secure, store, analyze, and transform data at exceptional scale.

The Online Storage team provides a set of managed databases as a platform, used to persist data for all Affirm services. Our platform enables self-service access to OLTP storage systems, including Relational DB(MySQL), KV(DynamoDB), Distributed SQL(TiDB) and Cache(Redis). As a team, we are responsible for various data and access patterns, including but not limited to mission-critical financial transactional data, data science models, and any new persistence use case. These responsibilities require us to learn and gain deep expertise in various database systems. 

We are looking for a talented Senior Software Engineer who can architect, build and scale Relational and Distributed SQL Databases identifying opportunities to improve how we build, productionize, operate and improve this mission-critical infrastructure to unlock substantial value within our business. You’ll have the opportunity to directly influence your team’s roadmap in close collaboration with your peers, share your knowledge and expertise with others and learn from some of the best on our shared mission to deliver honest financial products that improve lives.

What you’ll do

  • You will build and operate the control plane for large-scale distributed SQL databases such as MySQL and TiDB, automating provisioning, failover, backups and upgrades end to end.
  • You will design and execute reliability-focused schema and data migrations across multi-tenant database clusters, with zero downtime for the products that depend on them.
  • You will own the networking stack that connects services to storage on Kubernetes, including connection proxies such as ProxySQL, and tune it for latency, resilience and failover.
  • You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
  • You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
  • You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
  • You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

  • You have a total of 5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
  • You are experienced in designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, Terraform and Kubernetes.
  • You have in-depth, hands-on experience with large-scale database deployments in a production environment.
  • You have expertise in distributed databases and database technologies such as MySQL(Preferred), TiDB(Preferred), Postgres, Spanner, Vitess, CockroachDB etc.
  • Solid understanding of distributed database architecture, data modeling, and performance tuning. Particularly, expertise in SQL tuning and performance optimization techniques.
  • You have expertise in database benchmarking, load testing, and capacity planning.
  • You are familiar with connection poolers and proxies such as ProxySQL, RDS Proxy, Pg Bouncer, PgDog etc.
  • You have built control-plane or automation tooling for databases, such as provisioning, failover, upgrades or schema migrations, ideally on Kubernetes.
  • You have executed zero-downtime migrations and major version upgrades on production databases, and have built CLI tooling or runbooks to make those procedures repeatable.
  • You understand Kubernetes networking, service discovery and TLS well enough to debug connection and failover problems between services and databases.
  • You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
  • You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
  • Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Equity Grade - 9

title: Operations Enablement Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About Ops Enablement

The Operations Enablement team builds the capabilities required to deliver fast, accurate, and high-quality servicing experiences for Affirm’s customers and merchants—while identifying opportunities to eliminate the need for them to contact us in the first place. We partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Vendor Management, Legal, and Compliance to ensure every agent is trained, equipped, and able to deliver measurable results from day one.

Operating across the full servicing lifecycle, we translate new products, policies, and business requirements into scalable operational capabilities. Our work includes designing training and operational readiness strategies, standing up new servicing experiences, defining and measuring interaction quality, and ensuring agents can quickly access the information they need to resolve issues correctly.

We use performance insights, customer contact drivers, quality trends, and agent feedback to identify capability gaps and their root causes. We then build the learning programs, quality frameworks, knowledge systems, processes, and tools needed to close those gaps—while helping our Product and Engineering partners address friction upstream rather than requiring agents to absorb it downstream. By owning the full journey—from operationalizing new products and policies to improving existing workflows—Operations Enablement turns complex change into consistent, compliant, and high-quality servicing at scale.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Manager roles across Affirm's Ops Enablement organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across Ops Enablement.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

  • Customer Enablement: Owning and improving specific customer servicing experiences across multiple product offerings
  • Horizontal Enablement: Owning programs that touch multiple customer servicing experiences for specific product offerings

About the Role

As an Operations Enablement leader you will help to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to grow efficiently while maintaining exceptional customer and merchant outcomes.

You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. As a senior member of the Operations Enablement team, you will own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives aligned to strategic priorities—driving delivery across timelines, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. You will define and execute servicing strategies by developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans and be responsible for planning, coordination, documentation, change management and measurement across assigned initiatives to ensure operational readiness and measurable outcomes

This role works closely with partners across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure readiness for key business and regulatory changes. Serving as a connector between servicing strategy and day-to-day execution, you will translate strategy into scalable operational capabilities. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Program Performance: Lead complex cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities.
  • Define Program Roadmaps: Develop clear program roadmaps and execution plans, tracking progress against KPIs, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and risks.
  • Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong stakeholder engagement and governance practices, delivering clear, polished, and executive-ready communications on program status, outcomes, risks, and impact.
  • Manage Risk & Issue Resolution: Proactively identify risks, issues, and dependencies; propose data-backed solutions; and drive resolution in partnership with stakeholders.
  • Lead Operational Excellence: Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to identify root causes, implement scalable improvements, and continuously raise the bar for quality, efficiency, and compliance.
  • Own Change End-to-End: Manage the full lifecycle of process and product changes—from design and implementation through change management, adoption, and measurement—ensuring meaningful impact for customers and the business.
  • Build Technical Resources: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate technical concepts into clear manuals and resources for both human and AI agents.
  • Elevate Knowledge Management: Architect and evolve our knowledge ecosystem (SOPs, job aids, learning platforms, AI-enabled knowledge tools), ensuring resources are accurate, engaging, and accessible at scale.
  • Translate Technical Concepts: Apply technical depth to plan, design, and create complex operational, instructional, and procedural content, translating technical concepts into clear resources for both human and AI agents.
  • Own Learning & Training Strategy: Oversee end-to-end design and delivery of training programs (onboarding, continuous learning, new product rollouts), ensuring effectiveness through measurement and feedback loops.
  • Collaborate on Experience Improvements: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to deepen understanding of the current customer and agent experience and identify opportunities for workflow and experience optimization.
  • Expand Program Scope: Take on additional program and project management responsibilities as needed, developing working knowledge across adjacent domains to support evolving business needs.

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in program management or product operations, preferably within large-scale or global operations.
  • 3+ years of experience at a fintech or financial institution, including 3+ years in a role that involves scaling operations and providing ongoing coaching and feedback to team members.
  • Subject matter expert on financial regulations such as UCC, Reg E, Reg Z, Card Act, GLBA, UDAAP, GDPR, among others.  Have a deep understanding of dispute management rules, response codes, and recommended response data.
  • Certification in Six Sigma, Project Management or Design Thinking
  • Experience implementing and scaling knowledge management and training (Salesforce, Confluence, LMS platforms, or AI-driven knowledge tools).
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives with strong execution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong skills in strategic planning, issue/risk management and cross-functional execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to deliver polished, executive-ready updates and influence stakeholders. 
  • Proficiency in process mapping and workflow analysis
  • Proven experience designing business processes that drive a positive end user experience, reduce business risk and increase overall workflow efficiency. 
  • Experience building workflows within a regulatory environment. 
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support team collaboration, operational priorities, and vendor or partner engagements.

What we look for

  • 7+ years of experience in program management or product operations, preferably within large-scale or global operations including 2+ years of experience at a fintech or financial institution

  • 3+ years in a role that involves scaling operations and providing ongoing coaching and feedback to team members.

  • Subject matter expert on financial regulations such as UCC, Reg E, Reg Z, Card Act, GLBA, UDAAP, GDPR, among others.  Have a deep understanding of dispute management rules, response codes, and recommended response data.

  • Certification in Six Sigma, Project Management or Design Thinking
