title: Software Engineer II - CIAM
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm is building the next generation of customer identity and authentication. This role is a hands-on, mid-engineering position inside Information Security, contributing to core CIAM capabilities that protect customers and support growth.

You will help build and maintain backend services that power registration, login, authorization, and account lifecycle flows across B2C and B2B experiences. You will work with experienced engineers and partner teams to deliver scoped identity features with strong security fundamentals, reliability, and operational rigor.

What you’ll do

  • Build and ship customer-facing authentication features—from smoother login experiences to MFA, step-up authentication, and device binding—with mentorship from experienced engineers.
  • Develop backend services and APIs in Python or Kotlin, turning product requirements into working software that helps customers access their accounts securely.
  • Work with modern identity technologies such as Okta, Auth0, and ForgeRock, writing custom code and integrations that connect identity capabilities to web, mobile, and partner applications.
  • Take scoped features through the software development lifecycle: contribute to design, write readable code and automated tests, participate in code reviews, and deploy to production with support from the team.
  • Solve real engineering problems by debugging services, improving reliability, and using logs and metrics to understand how your code behaves in production.
  • Collaborate with engineering and product partners, learn secure development practices, and grow your software engineering skills while building expertise in authentication.

What we look for

We’re looking for a Mid-Level Software Engineer with solid engineering fundamentals, a passion for authentication, and an eagerness to learn customer identity and access management. You do not need extensive authentication or CIAM experience—we value your ability to build software, solve problems, and grow in the space.

  • Demonstrated ability to write, test, and debug software in Python, Kotlin, or a similar language through coursework, internships, personal projects, open source, or professional work. No fixed minimum years of experience required.
  • Foundational understanding of backend development, including APIs, data structures, databases, and version control.
  • Genuine curiosity about how authentication works and motivation to build secure, reliable customer experiences. Prior experience with identity protocols or CIAM platforms is a plus, not a requirement.
  • A practical problem-solving approach, willingness to ask questions, and openness to learning through mentorship and code review.
  • Clear communication and the ability to collaborate with engineering, product, and security teammates.
  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

descriptionHtml:

Join Affirm as a Machine Learning Engineering Manager and become a pivotal part of our International Credit Machine Learning group. Specifically, you will manage a team of ML engineers that builds the models powering credit lending decisions in countries across Europe and in Australia. You will lead your team in using novel ML techniques and rich data representations to predict repayment behavior and optimize how we offer loans to our borrowers.

In this role, you will help shape the future of machine learning at Affirm. title: Group Product Manager - Zero to One Labs
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Product Team

The Product team listens to our customers’ needs and translates those insights into a clear product vision. The team works closely with design, engineering, and analytics to build scalable financial products that empower people to manage their money with confidence. We rely on empathy, curiosity, and business sense to prioritize features and improve experiences. Our role is to lead with clarity, support cross-functional execution, and champion the user in every decision.

About the Role

The ZT1 Labs group is a small, senior team of product and engineering experts working directly with the CEO on the company’s most important new bets. This team takes on highly ambiguous, cross-functional problems where the upside is company-defining.

We are looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a portfolio of ZT1 initiatives in a hands-on builder role, with direct product ownership and with no direct people management responsibilities. You will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for new products and platforms, partnering closely with engineers, analysts, and designers to build and launch, and with revenue and business teams to bring new products to market and scale.

You’ll work closely with the CEO and executive team to turn high-level ideas into durable, scalable businesses.

What You Will Do

Understand Customers & Strategic Context: 

  • Build a deep understanding of Affirm’s global network of users, merchants, and partners.

  • Connect customer insights and market trends to long-term company strategy to identify where zero-to-one innovation can drive outsized impact.

  • Track relevant product, technology, and industry shifts and use them to inform product direction.

 Set Vision, Strategy, and Roadmap

  • Partner with the CEO and senior leaders to define problem spaces and opportunity areas that matter most for Affirm’s future.

  • Craft a clear product vision and strategic narrative for the innovation portfolio, translating that into a focused and prioritized roadmap.

  • Define crisp outcomes and success metrics tied directly to business impact (GMV, profitability, conversion, retention, long-term moat). 

Lead Zero-to-One Product Development

  • Drive the full lifecycle for new products and platforms: discovery, validation, MVP definition, launch, and iteration.

  • Own the full UI/UX, using AI tools to build and iterate on working prototypes that make product ideas tangible and testable.

  • Write and refine customer-facing copy across the product experience, from onboarding to in-product guidance.

  • Independently analyze customer behavior, build funnels, and use data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.

  • Own experimentation end to end, including hypotheses, test design, success metrics, results analysis, and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to sync ZT1 roadmaps with core product roadmaps, ensuring high product quality, an aligned user experience, and cohesive business results.

 Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership

  • Lead a cross-functional group (engineering, design, data, risk, capital, operations, revenue, legal and compliance) through ambiguous and complex work.

  • Serve as a thought partner to the CEO and executive team on new product bets, tradeoffs, and prioritization.

  • Communicate clearly and often - framing decisions, risks, and tradeoffs; writing high-quality docs; and maintaining alignment across teams.

 Raise the Bar for Product Craft

  • Establish product patterns, decision frameworks, and execution standards that make zero-to-one work repeatable and scalable.

  • Model strong product thinking, rigor, and judgment for senior peers without managing them directly.

  • Help shape the culture and operating model of the ZT1 function.
     

What We Look For

Experience

  • ~8–10+ years of product management experience with a strong track record shipping and scaling consumer-facing or platform products.

  • Previous ownership of technical software products end-to-end and ability to clearly articulate the business impact.

  • Direct experience leading zero-to-one or highly ambiguous product areas with meaningful outcomes.

  • Experience working closely with engineering, data, design, and other teams without direct authority.

  • Skilled at operating in complex environments where success depends on coordinating cross-functional work across multiple groups. 

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience is a plus. Ability to spot opportunities, build from scratch, test quickly, and take ownership of outcomes.

Skills

  • Hands-on fluency with AI tools for prototyping, design, content, and analysis, with the judgment to evaluate and refine the output.

  • Comfortable doing the work directly without dedicated design, analytics, or content partners.

  • Strong communicator capable of securing alignment and decisions from broad groups of senior stakeholders with differing priorities.

  • Adept at influencing engineering teams outside your reporting line - able to guide them toward building what the product needs.

  • High judgment in ambiguous spaces - able to take incomplete or conflicting information and turn it into a clear, actionable plan.

  • Strong commercial instincts - able to contribute to pitches, negotiations, and contract evaluations when product work intersects with business strategy.

Behaviors & Traits

  • Bias toward action; cares about unblocking teams and driving meaningful progress quickly.

  • Comfortable moving between strategy and execution - from long-term roadmap thinking to writing specs or digging into edge cases.

  • Strong organizational discipline and interpersonal skills, able to navigate complex dynamics while maintaining momentum.

  • Deep sense of ownership - holds a high bar for quality and ships products on time.

  • Mission-driven and customer-obsessed, motivated to build honest, transparent financial products.

title: Senior Product Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:

Affirm values information security as a critical part of the company’s continued success. Our mission is to make information security programmatic and cultural in Affirm, enabling the company to succeed in building honest financial products. The Security team posture increases security and reduces risk while securely enabling access to information for those who need it!

The Senior Product Security Engineer candidate will have experience building and architecting software as part of a larger team. The ideal candidate will work effectively with product and engineering teams to evaluate and influence product requirements, design, and implementation to improve the security of Affirm’s products.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Affirm product teams to ensure that security is included in every phase of the product development lifecycle.

  • Review and analyze product source code to identify security vulnerabilities and provide recommendations for secure implementation.

  • Seek out opportunities to automate processes when appropriate.

  • Identify emerging classes of vulnerabilities and developing solutions for them before they’re a problem.

  • Assist product teams in the development of security focused test cases to enforce security requirements.

  • Advise product teams on business security requirements early in the product development lifecycle.

  • Decompose large, cross-team projects into individual tasks. Manage scope across teams and drive toward project closure.

What We Look For

  • Deep understanding of web application architecture and design principles

  • Experience using modern software development and delivery techniques to develop cloud-based services. Python, Kotlin, Java, AWS, and Azure experience preferred.

  • Knowledge of common security flaws and resolution as published by OWASP, SANS, etc.

  • Experience with PCI or other regulated environments. 

  • Experience conducting threat models for complex, distributed products using standard threat modeling techniques and methodologies.

  • Experience with standard authentication mechanisms, including SAML and OAuth2.

  • Understanding of continuous integration / continuous deployment processes and tools.

title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering (Card)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Engineering team
The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.

About the role
We are reinventing credit cards entirely. We are working directly with card issuers to change how credit is used throughout the world, creating new types of cards that work for both their everyday lives and large purchases with extremely straightforward, flexible terms. We are looking for a Senior Manager Software Engineering to lead teams centered around integrations with partners, processors, and internationalization.  Your mission will be to decrease the time it takes for our teams to integrate with external partners dramatically and allow us to launch cards as soon as we launch Affirm in a new country. You’ll partner with other engineering leaders in revolutionizing the way the team works, shaping the culture of engineering across Cards.  

You will lead from the front on AI while holding the bar high on quality.  You’ll collaborate with other managers across the organization to create a psychologically safe team.  You will work closely with stakeholders in the EU and US to build products customers want, and are scalable, reliable, and high-performing. You'll help shape best practices, guide architectural choices, and drive the successful delivery of critical initiatives.

What you’ll do

  • Hire the right people - We are still actively growing our teams in Spain and Poland. You will lead the way on hiring.

  • Build the team culture - Set a high standard and great team culture in your growing organization.

  • Lead the vision – Define the technical direction, long-term technical roadmap, and strategic initiatives in Cards.

  • Be a role model - Lead from the front as an example in using AI to build fast, take initiative, and revolutionize how we work.

  • Work closely with stakeholders across all teams at Affirm to champion and implement technical excellence in conjunction with business results 

  • Create and influence a strong ownership culture across teams, with high accountability and investment for building for scale and efficiency

  • Mentor and lead – Guide a strong group of managers and engineers

  • On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.

What we look for

  • You have 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams and 2+ years managing managers.

  • You have led a multi-team engineering org through a multi-year technical strategy, breaking ambiguous requirements into deliverables that shipped.

  • You have the technical depth to guide architecture, reliability and quality decisions across a portfolio of systems. You also let tech leads and architects make the calls.

  • You make investment and prioritization decisions even when people disagree or consensus is incomplete, and you change course when the evidence changes.

  • You explain strategy, risk and tradeoffs in terms that make sense to engineers, cross-functional partners and executives.

  • You have grown managers into senior leaders and built teams where diverse perspectives are included and valued on merit.

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

title: Senior Manager, Narrative Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Brand & Communications Team
The Brand & Communications team crafts and shares Affirm’s story to build trust, elevate our brand, and drive business impact. The Brand Creative team leads conceptually bold, strategically grounded work across channels—from owned content to paid media. The PR & Communications team handles internal and external messaging, ensuring our values show up in media, exec visibility, and employee storytelling. Together, we manage brand strategy, content, campaigns, media relations, and communications. We connect meaningfully with customers, partners, and the public while championing Affirm’s mission.

About the Role

We want more people to understand what makes Affirm different and choose us with confidence. To make that happen, we need a rigorous understanding of our audiences and a clear, measurable view of whether our story is resonating.

The Senior Manager, Narrative Intelligence will build the analytical intelligence function behind Affirm’s Brand & Communications strategy. You’ll connect original research, Affirm’s first-party data, brand and media measurement, behavioral signals, and external datasets to understand our audiences, identify what shapes their perceptions, and find where our story can connect more meaningfully.

You’ll turn a complex mix of data into a clear point of view that shapes Affirm’s narrative and the work we put into the world. Then you’ll close the loop: defining how we measure narrative performance, determining what is and isn’t working, and identifying what we should do differently as a result.

The ambition is to make intelligence an operating system for the work—not a report that arrives after it—and set a new standard for how Brand & Communications uses data to make decisions

What You’ll Do

  • Build an evidence-based understanding of our priority audiences. Lead research and analysis into who they are, what they value, how they behave, what they believe about Affirm and the category, and what could change those beliefs. Use segmentation, surveys, behavioral data, and other analytical approaches to identify the variables that matter most.
  • Develop Affirm’s narrative measurement framework. Define the metrics, methodologies, and baselines we use to evaluate narrative performance across audiences, channels, and time horizons. Partner with Analytics, User Research, Marketing, and other teams to strengthen attribution, experimentation, and our understanding of how narrative and reputation contribute to business outcomes.
  • Build the team’s intelligence system. Create the tools, dashboards, analytical standards, and shared knowledge base that make audience intelligence and performance data easy to find, interpret, and apply. Help the broader team become more analytically confident over time.
  • Own the narrative feedback loop. Build a continuous, data-informed picture of how Affirm’s story is landing. Diagnose what is breaking through, what is being misunderstood or ignored, where perceptions are shifting, and what the evidence suggests we should do next.
  • Connect the evidence. Bring together qualitative research, surveys, brand health, media and social intelligence, search and cultural signals, campaign performance, behavioral data, and Affirm’s own customer and business data. Draw on credible external research about culture, commerce, credit, and the forces shaping how people think and behave. Find patterns, test relationships, surface contradictions, and assess the strength of the evidence.
  • Turn analysis into narrative strategy. Translate findings into clear implications for Affirm’s positioning, messaging, campaigns, content, and communications planning. Partner with the Head of Story to build and evolve Affirm’s narrative based on what the data tells us.
  • Design studies that answer consequential questions. Turn ambiguous business and communications questions into testable hypotheses and rigorous research. Choose the right mix of surveys, experiments, observational analysis, and qualitative inquiry to produce evidence the team can act on.

What We Look For

  • You’re driven to understand people through data. You’re curious about the beliefs and motivations beneath human behavior and equally interested in whether the evidence supports the story being told.
  • You’ve spent 12+ years in consumer analytics, audience insights, data science, measurement, strategic intelligence, quantitative research, or a related field. You’ve used analysis to shape brand, communications, marketing, product, or creative strategy.
  • You’re highly fluent in quantitative research and analysis. You’re comfortable with survey design, segmentation, statistical inference, experimentation, measurement design, and large or imperfect datasets. You work directly with data, using tools such as SQL, statistical platforms, data visualization, or business intelligence tools.
  • You know how to build a complete picture from different forms of evidence. You can integrate qualitative insight and quantitative analysis, account for the limits of each source, and translate concepts such as trust, relevance, reputation, and narrative resonance into thoughtful analytical frameworks.
  • You turn analysis into decisions. You can take a messy body of evidence, determine which signals matter, and explain what they mean for the narrative, the work, and the choices in front of us. Your conclusions are clear, memorable, and useful to both analytical and creative audiences.
  • You work well across analytical, strategic, and creative disciplines. You can collaborate credibly with data scientists and researchers, then translate the work for writers, strategists, executives, and communications leaders.
  • You’d rather discover something inconvenient than confirm what everyone already believes. You test assumptions, challenge weak evidence, and follow the data—even when it complicates the current story.

title: Leadership Development Manager
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the team

The People team helps Affirmers cultivate a high-performing, inclusive organization. We focus on three core areas: attracting talent aligned to our mission, enabling growth through people and team development, and retaining employees through thoughtful experiences and rewards. We develop Affirm’s people programs and systems to create a workplace where all employees can thrive and contribute meaningfully. By investing in our people, we create a long-term advantage for the business.

About the role

A great first manager can shape someone's entire experience at work. At Affirm, we're investing in emerging and new people leaders so they can build high-performing teams and help every Affirmer do the most impactful work of their career.

As our Leadership Development Manager, Emerging and New Leaders, you'll shape how aspiring, first-time, and newly hired people leaders build the skills and confidence to lead at Affirm. You'll own the development journey from the moment someone considers becoming a leader through their first year in the role, creating practical, engaging experiences that help leaders navigate real challenges and build high-performing teams.

This is an opportunity to build meaningful development experiences at scale. You'll combine creative learning design, audience insights, and the needs of the business to make leadership development accessible, relevant, and effective in our remote-first environment. Working closely with partners across the People team, you'll have the autonomy to test new ideas, improve existing programs, and make a lasting impact on how leadership takes shape at Affirm.

What you'll do

  • Own the new-leader experience. Lead the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of leadership development programs for aspiring, first-time, and newly hired people leaders, including Leading@, Leader 101, and other foundational learning experiences.
  • Build learning journeys that meet leaders where they are. Create timely, practical support for key leadership transitions, from preparing for a first management role to navigating performance conversations, coaching employees, and building strong teams.
  • Design engaging experiences that scale. Combine interactive workshops, peer learning, self-directed resources, and hands-on practice to help leaders build skills they can apply immediately, wherever they work.
  • Create opportunities for leaders to learn together. Build communities and peer learning experiences that help new leaders connect, share challenges, exchange feedback, and grow through one another's experiences.
  • Turn leadership expectations into everyday actions. Translate Affirm's leadership expectations into practical tools and experiences that help leaders build self-awareness, coach employees, give feedback, manage performance, and support their teams. Incorporate leadership assessments and coaching where they can deepen learning and accelerate growth.
  • Partner across the People team. Work with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Learning to connect leadership development with hiring, promotions, onboarding, and ongoing employee growth.
  • Experiment, learn, and improve. Gather feedback, test new approaches, and use data to understand what's working. Prioritize improvements that make learning more effective and easier to access.
  • Measure what matters. Define and track measures of program effectiveness, including skill development, early leadership effectiveness, and performance indicators. Use data and feedback to improve experiences and demonstrate their impact on leaders and teams.
  • Keep programs running smoothly. Manage learning resources, communications, vendors, and budgets to deliver consistent, high-quality experiences for a growing leadership audience.

What we look for

  • 8+ years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree, 6+ years with a Master's degree, 3+ years with a PhD, or equivalent experience in leadership development, learning and development, talent management, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and delivering leadership development programs for new or first-time people leaders, with a track record of creating learning experiences that work at scale.
  • Strong learning and experience design skills, including the ability to create engaging, practical programs that blend live learning, digital resources, and hands-on application.
  • A product-oriented approach to learning and development, with experience gathering audience insights, prioritizing improvements, and using feedback and data to guide decisions.
  • Experience building learning communities, peer networks, or cohort-based programs that encourage connection and continued development.
  • Experience integrating leadership assessments and coaching into development programs to build self-awareness, strengthen leadership skills, and support ongoing growth.
  • Strong program management and collaboration skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, build trusted relationships, and influence cross-functional partners to deliver high-quality experiences.
  • A creative, resourceful approach to solving complex problems, with a willingness to experiment, learn, and continuously improve.
  • Comfort using data and emerging technologies, including AI tools, to improve learning experiences, streamline processes, and measure impact.

Equity Grade - 6

title: Senior Technical Account Manager (Strategic Alliances)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (Senior TAM, L6) at Affirm, you will own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, delivering against SLAs, fielding technical inquiries, and performing investigations and analysis, while also driving technical initiatives that translate merchant business objectives into technical strategies and product optimizations. Senior TAMs are part of the Engineering team and collaborate closely with Affirm's Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Frontline Technical Support teams.

This is an operations-heavy role to start. Expect the majority of your early focus to be on keeping merchant integrations healthy—monitoring, triage, troubleshooting, and SLA delivery—while you progressively take on more custom solutioning and cross-functional initiatives. Over your first 6–12 months, as you build operational mastery, you will grow into owning your own book of accounts and carrying it through to end-to-end account ownership.

A Senior TAM independently owns operational health across the strategic alliance portfolio, designs custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations, drives cross-team collaboration on initiatives, acts as a technical lead on team projects, and mentors less-experienced members of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and fielding technical inquiries—so integrations stay healthy and issues are resolved quickly.

  • Deliver against SLAs, proactively surfacing technical risks before they become customer-impacting and responding with urgency to merchant issues.

  • Perform in-depth investigations and root-cause analysis across logs, queries, and integration data, owning resolution end to end and escalating to cross-functional partners or executives when needed.

  • Drive technical initiatives and partner with internal and merchant stakeholders on launch initiatives—expansions, promotions, new product adoption, and integration optimizations—that grow the value of the accounts after launch.

title: Senior Manager, Policy & Communications Campaigns
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Brand and Communications Team

Brand & Communications shapes how the world understands Affirm and how Affirm shows up in it. We meet people where perception forms: in culture, in the press, across our owned and paid channels, and inside the company. We aim to make our work compound over time, moving at the speed of culture while holding a high bar for craft and clarity. Our job across comms, brand, creative, and social is to make Affirm a brand people trust and are proud to choose.

About the Role

Affirm's model only works when consumers succeed. No late fees. The full cost, known before you commit. A balance that ends.

Many people don't know that. Pay-over-time products are treated as interchangeable, and the revolving credit card is treated as the responsible default. We want to change this dynamic and evolve thinking and beliefs around what consumer-friendly credit can and should be as it modernizes.

The timing is the opportunity. Credit is being rewritten right now, in regulation, in coverage, and in how people talk about debt. The beliefs that settle over the next few years will shape the decades that follow.

This role focuses on the people who shape what the public understands about credit, the ones creating the coverage and content that drives the conversation.

You know who covers what, who matters beyond their outlet’s size, which newsletter a Hill staffer reads before the front page. And you know how to proactively build an argument that travels. The policymakers, regulators, and advocates who set the terms will use it, and the most skeptical reporter will want to write it.

You won’t be doing it alone. You’ll collaborate with colleagues who own the narrative you’re carrying, the research behind it, and the versions of this story told to consumers, merchants, and investors. You’ll also partner closely with a policy team that owns our government relationships and the positions we take. And because this story has to build across audiences and surfaces, you’ll help shape the broader brand and comms strategy rather than only drawing from it.

This story lives at the nexus of New York City andWashington, DC, so you can be based in either with regular time in the other.

What You'll Do

  • Develop the strategy and run the campaign. Decide what we’re trying to change, with whom, and in what order. Set the sequence, pick the moments, and know what each one is supposed to do. Shift the dynamic from an idea we’re explaining to language other people naturally use.

  • Shape what becomes news. Be in the conversations where people are deciding what to cover and what counts as news, weaving Affirm into them rather than reacting to them.

  • Build the proof. Help shape original consumer research and third-party data into evidence that lets people outside Affirm make the argument correctly and persuasively without us in the room.

  • Build the media bench. Earn the trust of a focused group of reporters, columnists, editors, producers, podcasters, and independent writers who shape consumer finance and policy conversations, and become the source they come back to, including on stories that aren’t about us.

  • Partner on outside voices. Work with our public affairs and government relations team to build lasting relationships with consumer advocates, academics, and credit experts, starting with listening rather than endorsement requests. Design the dinners, briefings, and roundtables where the right people meet each other and the argument gets pressure-tested in person.

  • Put our perspective where decisions get made. Prepare executives and credible outside spokespeople for the moments that matter, from op-eds to panels and interviews, and work with public affairs so the arguments and themes we care about reach policymakers, regulators, and the people who advise them.

  • Know whether it is working. Track whether the argument is actually showing up: in how reporters frame the category, in the language advocates and policymakers use, in earned sentiment. Bring the honest read, including when a tactic is visible but not moving anything.

What We Look For

  • Campaign mindset: You think in arcs rather than announcements, built around the forces that actually shape the public conversation, and you know it’s landing when others start making the argument without you.

  • Media relationships and craft: 12+ years in communications, with real relationships across policy, business, and tech media, and a track record running complicated press strategies end to end, including complex or sticky situations.

  • Policy communications experience: You’ve run communications on policy issues, whether in advocacy, regulatory affairs, a political campaign, or a public affairs practice. You understand how an issue actually gets decided, who moves it, and how long it takes.

  • A connector: You keep relationships across the worlds you work in and put people together because it’s useful to them, not only when it serves you.

  • Proactive instinct: A bias for creating the story rather than chasing it, an eye for using moments others create, and the tenacity to stay with a good idea past the first no.

  • Appetite for a complicated subject: You don’t need a credit background. You need to get deep on underwriting, disclosure, and the credit system, and then explain it in plain language.

  • Sharp, persuasive writing: The ability to build an argument that carries, clear, accurate, and convincing to someone who starts out skeptical.

  • Sound judgment: Steadiness in high-stakes, high-visibility moments, and the discipline to act quickly without putting trust at risk.

  • Collaborative partnership: Strong working relationships across Comms, Brand, Public Affairs, Legal, and Marketing, and the desire to make other people’s work better and not only your own.

  • Belief that transparency is an advantage: You think clarity and accountability are brand advantages, not compliance requirements.

While Affirm is a remote-first company, the nature of this position requires candidates to be based in New York City or Washington, DC (or the surrounding area), or be willing to relocate to either location before their start date.

title: Senior Manager, Security Incident Response
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the InfoSec team
At Affirm, security is integral to our mission of building honest financial products and driving the company’s long-term success. The Security Operations and Resilience Engineering (SOR) program is the foundation of our prevention, detection, and response capabilities, helping safeguard Affirm’s assets and enterprise security ecosystem. As part of our Security Team, you’ll join a group of passionate, highly skilled professionals redefining fintech security through collaboration, innovation, and a team-first mindset.

About the role
We’re seeking an experienced security leader to lead Affirm’s global security investigations and incident response program as we expand internationally. This leader will guide complex investigations and incidents while building the operating practices, readiness, and technical capabilities needed to support consistent response across regions and scale with the business.

In this role, you’ll lead a technically deep, engineering-oriented team that manages major incidents and builds better response capabilities. You’ll direct complex investigations while staying close to the technical work, bring structure to ambiguity, guide responders and executives through critical decisions, and turn incident findings into durable engineering improvements. You’ll also help shape AI-enabled investigation workflows, including agentic approaches to evidence gathering, analysis, and coordination, with human oversight and clear security, privacy, and operational safeguards.


What you’ll do

  • Lead security incidents and investigations across the full lifecycle, from initial assessment through containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review.

  • Serve as incident commander for major security events, set clear roles and decision paths, and coordinate large technical and cross-functional response groups through ambiguity.

  • Guide technical investigations and root-cause analyses with engineering teams, validate fixes, and drive durable corrective actions across the business.

  • Manage and develop a technical, engineering-oriented response team, set priorities, coach engineers, and build incident command depth and consistent execution across regions.

  • Set operating objectives and global readiness practices, including playbooks, escalation paths, exercises, on-call readiness, postmortems, and measures of response effectiveness.

  • Drive engineering improvements to response tooling, security telemetry, detection, and automation, including agentic AI workflows that support investigation and analysis with appropriate human oversight and security and privacy safeguards.

  • Translate complex security and incident metrics into actionable executive dashboards and board-level risk reporting, surfacing trends and remediation priorities that drive cross-functional action.

What we look for

  • 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a related security field.

  • Proven ability to lead major security incidents and investigations in technology-driven, cloud-native environments, from detection and assessment through containment, remediation, and recovery.

  • Strong technical foundation in security operations, with depth in investigations, incident response, detection, root-cause analysis, and/or digital forensics across cloud and enterprise environments. Experience in fintech or payments, and familiarity with using threat intelligence to inform response, are nice to have.

  • Experience managing and developing technical or engineering teams, setting direction and priorities, coaching engineers, and guiding hands-on incident work alongside engineering improvements.

  • Track record of building scalable response capabilities through repeatable practices, on-call readiness, exercises, postmortems, operational measures, and security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, or SOAR.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including translating complex incidents, security metrics, and customer or business impact into clear executive updates and board-level reporting, and aligning cross-functional partners.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently move ambiguous work forward, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and drive investigations, remediation, and program improvements to completion with measurable results.

  • An AI-forward mindset and sound judgment in applying AI to security operations, including agentic investigation or automation workflows with human oversight and appropriate security, privacy, and operational safeguards.

descriptionHtml:

As a Manager of Sales Engineering, you’ll combine your People Come First leadership, technical depth, and communication skills to help enterprise merchant partners evaluate and integrate Affirm. title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer (Credit International ML)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.


About the role
We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to be the technical leader building high-quality production-grade models powering credit lending decisions in countries across Europe and in Australia. You will use novel ML techniques and rich data representations to predict repayment behavior and optimize how we offer loans to our borrowers. In this role, you will help shape the future of how machine learning fuels Affirm’s global expansion. You'll partner with engineering, product, and risk leaders to design, implement, and scale advanced ML solutions that drive critical capabilities across the company. You will mentor engineers, bring clarity to complex, ambiguous problems, and contribute to a cohesive long-term ML strategy.

What you’ll do

* You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

* You will collaborate with ML Platform, product, engineering, and risk leadership to shape long-term modeling capabilities needed for scalable international expansion.

* You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

* You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards.

* You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What we look for

* 8+ years of experience researching, designing, deploying, and operating large-scale, real-time machine learning systems. A relevant PhD can count for up to 2 YOE.

* Strong Python skills and experience writing production-quality code.

* Experience building and evaluating models for tabular classification problems (including gradient-boosted decision trees like LightGBM/XGBoost, and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch).

* Experience working with distributed data processing or parallel compute frameworks (e.g. Spark, Ray).

* Experience with ML lifecycle tooling for training orchestration, experimentation, and model monitoring (e.g., Kubeflow, Airflow, MLflow).

* Proficient in using AI-powered developer tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to accelerate the model development lifecycle.

* Strong engineering skills and the ability to provide hands-on technical leadership while working with our code and architecture.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.


Total Rewards

We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Compute Platform)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

What you’ll do

As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

  • Architect and evolve Affirm's EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components

  • Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows

  • Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently

  • Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc

  • Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads

  • Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time

  • Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly

  • Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection

  • Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

What we look for

  • Deep EKS and Kubernetes internals expertise, including cluster upgrades, node lifecycle, scheduling, and autoscaling (Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler)

  • Demonstrated experience automating Kubernetes operations at fleet scale, from cluster provisioning, upgrades, and node lifecycle to self-healing remediation and policy-driven enforcement, replacing manual toil with auditable, self-service workflows

  • Strong grasp of workload reliability patterns: resource tuning, probes, PDBs, topology and isolation constraints

  • Experience designing and enforcing platform standards through policy (admission control, OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent) and automated frameworks

  • Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and a GitOps or pipeline-driven delivery model (ArgoCD, kube-applier, or similar)

  • Observability instincts: defining SLOs, building metrics, logs, and alerting coverage, and running data-driven baseline audits

  • Cross-functional collaboration skills with platform, product, SRE, and capacity teams

  • Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across teams

  • Drive to track emerging Kubernetes community best practices and adapt them to Affirm's needs

 Qualifications

  • 10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering with proven delivery of complex platform solutions

  • 6+ years hands-on operating production Kubernetes at scale, ideally EKS on AWS

  • Strong cloud-native architecture experience on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS)

  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Spacelift a plus) and GitOps-style deployment pipelines

  • Expert-level proficiency in Go or Python and a proven track record building production-grade Kubernetes controllers, operators, and platform tooling that other engineering teams depend on

  • Track record designing and enforcing standards across many teams without becoming a bottleneck

  • Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking skills

  • Demonstrated leadership and cross-functional influence

  • Excellent communication skills

Base Pay Grade - R

Equity Grade - 15

title: Staff Software Engineer, Backend (Observability)
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Observability team builds the platform every Affirm engineer relies on to understand the behavior and performance of our systems. Our platform ingests 200+ TB/day of metrics, logs, and traces from hundreds of services across 80+ Kubernetes clusters, and when a user's checkout fails, our data is how engineers find out why. Over the next year, we’re moving to wide events, with one context-rich event per request, improving the signal-to-noise ratio to make debugging faster. We’re also introducing log sampling and building observability best practices into agentic development and code review, so that AI-assisted code is well instrumented by default.

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to be the technical lead for Observability. You’ll spend most of your time hands-on while defining the roadmap, driving cross-functional projects, mentoring a team of six engineers, and partnering closely with infrastructure and product teams.


What You'll Do

· You will own the architecture of Affirm’s telemetry pipeline, balancing reliability, query performance, and cost at 200+ TB/day.
· You will design log sampling strategies that significantly reduce volume and cost without losing the signal engineers need during incidents.
· You will shape how observability fits into agentic development, so that AI coding agents and code review catch instrumentation gaps before code ships.
· You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.
· You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.
· You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.
· You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.


What We Look For

· You have 8+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have an extensive track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL, Flink and Kubernetes.
· You have built or operated high-volume telemetry systems (metrics, logs, and/or traces) using technologies like OpenTelemetry, Kafka, and Terraform.
· You have a well-informed point of view on modern observability practices such as structured and wide events, sampling, cardinality management, and SLOs.
· You have driven adoption of a platform standard across many engineering teams, through both tooling and engagement.
· You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.
· Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

The Account Management team is part of Trust & Safety within Affirm’s Checkout organization. We build secure, intuitive experiences that help customers protect, manage, and recover access to their accounts. Our mission is to make account security seamless without adding unnecessary friction, ensuring customers can confidently use Affirm when and where they need it.

Our work spans the full account security journey - from detecting and preventing unauthorized access to enabling self-service recovery and reducing the need for customer support. We own critical experiences like Self-Service Phone Change, Settings & Security Center, and account information updates. These solutions directly impact customer trust, fraud prevention, and Affirm’s ability to scale safely.

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, thrives in complexity, and enjoys turning difficult security challenges into simple, meaningful customer experiences.

What You'll Do

  • You will be responsible for setting technical strategy for your team on a year-long time scale, and help your team tie it together with critical, business-impacting projects.

  • You will collaborate across teams in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics to ensure technical sustainability, risks and trade-offs are well understood and managed.

  • You will act as a force-multiplier for your team through your definition and advocacy of technical solutions and operational processes.

  • You take ownership of your team’s operations and availability by ensuring you have the right monitoring, triage rotations, playbooks, polcities, testing and alerting in place to support “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.

  • You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.

  • You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

What We Look For

  • You have a total of 8+ years of experience as a software engineer.

  • You are proficient in designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale technologies like Python, Kotlin, AWS, MySQL, and Kubernetes

  • You are proficient in developing web apps using declarative UI frameworks like React or Vue.

  • You have experience delivering major features, system components or deprecating existing functionality in a system through the definition of a technical and execution plan. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.

  • You thrive in ambiguity, and are comfortable moving from low level language idioms all the way to the architecture of large systems to understand how they work.

  • Your growth and impact trajectory demonstrates that you have mastered gathering and iterating on feedback from your engineering and cross-functional peers.

  • You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.

  • This position requires either equivalent practical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Base Pay Grade - P

Equity Grade - 13

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA Pacific base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT): $230,000 - $290,000

USA Sapphire base pay range (all other U.S. states): $204,00 - $264,000 

   #LI-Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

title: Vice President, Deputy General Counsel, Product, Regulatory & Litigation
descriptionHtml:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team 

The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

About the role

Affirm's Legal team partners with the business to drive innovation and support the scaling of our consumer financial products while expertly managing complex regulatory, litigation, and enforcement risks globally.

This senior leadership position will report directly to the Chief Legal Officer & Chief Compliance Officer (CLO/CCO) and lead across the US and international jurisdictions, Affirm’s Product, Regulatory, Innovation, Licensing, Litigation & Enforcement teams. The ideal candidate will build and lead a team of professionals, skilled in all legal matters related to these domains and will be skilled in strategizing and developing products for the Company. This role will also partner closely with the executive team including the CEO, CLO & CCO, Chief Operations Officer, SVP Product, SVP Engineering, CISO & other executives, along with other cross-functional groups, to ensure that our product, regulatory, licensing, litigation and enforcement legal work supports the company and is cohesive, holistic, and aligned with the strategic and operational needs of the business. Necessary experience and skills include critical thinking in the development and provision of legal  analyses and the provision of strategic counsel, strong and effective written and oral communication skills, and a demonstrated ability to lead while seamlessly and collegially partnering with internal and external teammates. The ideal candidate will join the leadership team for the CLO organization and provide important cross-department leadership and strategic guidance to the CLO and the leadership team. 

What you’ll do

  • Develop and execute strategic plans for Affirm’s Product, Regulatory, Innovation, Licensing, Litigation & Enforcement functions based on broader company strategies, ensuring alignment of global strategy and organizational growth.
  • Provide strategic direction and leadership across Product, Regulatory, Innovation, Licensing, Litigation, & Enforcement through senior legal leaders, ensuring alignment of priorities, accountability, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Counsel senior management, executive leaders, board members, and regulators as a trusted advisor on all product, litigation, and regulatory matters.
  • Partner with Product, Technology, Engineering, Bank, and other cross-functional leaders to provide strategic legal guidance on product development, innovation, bank-related initiatives, and complex federal, state, and international consumer financial regulatory matters.
  • Oversee legal strategy and responses related to federal and state regulatory inquiries, bank partner examinations, and enforcement actions, partnering closely with Regulatory Affairs, Public Affairs, and Compliance to anticipate and mitigate material regulatory risks.
  • Develop solutions in partnership with cross-functional leaders to address complex, company-wide problems, building consensus to drive long-term business initiatives.
  • Accountable for functional-level financial results and budgets, including judiciously managing outside counsel and litigation spend

What we look for

  • J.D. degree and a state bar member in good standing.
  • 20 years of legal experience, including law firm and government (CFPB or FTC) or in-house supporting consumer financial, payments, litigation, and enforcement matters at a fintech or technology company.
  • Expert knowledge of core functions, including federal and state consumer protection lending laws, financial technology, payments, and litigation.
  • Strong thought leadership and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to build cross-functional leadership consensus and implement organizational growth.
  • Experience interacting with executive leaders, board members, and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage change, develop risk mitigation plans, and translate long-term strategies into near-term focus (2-4 years).
  • Experience scaling teams and a strong desire to manage, develop, and mentor other senior attorneys and paraprofessionals

Base Pay Grade - X

Equity Grade - USA 24

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
